name: TTT-Discover published task set
classification: evaluated discovery-system task set, not a standalone benchmark suite
task_count_policy: A dataset or hardware-specific evaluator contract is a separate task variant; the paper reports every attempted problem, yielding 11 published variants.

tasks.name: Erdős minimum overlap
tasks.question: Construct a normalized nonnegative function that minimizes the largest overlap with a translated copy.
tasks.input: The mathematical problem, an executable scorer, and the evolving archive/history of candidate constructions.
tasks.output: A candidate construction encoded by executable program/state data.
tasks.evaluation: The released deterministic verifier evaluates the maximum translated overlap under the task normalization.
tasks.environment: TTT-Discover mathematics environment; Python/JAX execution with evaluator feedback and Tinker-based test-time RL.

tasks.name: First autocorrelation inequality (AC1)
tasks.question: Find a nonnegative function that minimizes the upper-bound constant in the first autocorrelation inequality.
tasks.input: The inequality, discretization, executable convolution scorer, and candidate-search feedback.
tasks.output: A nonnegative discretized function or program that generates it.
tasks.evaluation: The verifier computes the normalized maximum autoconvolution value; lower is better.
tasks.environment: TTT-Discover mathematics environment; Python/JAX execution with evaluator feedback and Tinker-based test-time RL.

tasks.name: Second autocorrelation inequality (AC2)
tasks.question: Construct a function that maximizes the lower-bound constant in the second autocorrelation inequality.
tasks.input: The inequality, discretization, executable scorer, and candidate-search feedback.
tasks.output: A candidate discretized function or generating program.
tasks.evaluation: The released verifier evaluates the task's normalized lower-bound constant; higher is better.
tasks.environment: TTT-Discover mathematics environment; Python/JAX execution with evaluator feedback and Tinker-based test-time RL.

tasks.name: GPUMode TriMul — A100
tasks.question: Implement a correct high-performance triangular-multiplication kernel for the supplied AlphaFold-style workload on NVIDIA A100.
tasks.input: Reference PyTorch operator, tensor shapes/dtypes, correctness tests, benchmark harness, and runtime feedback.
tasks.evaluation: GPUMode first checks numerical correctness and then measures latency on A100; lower runtime is better.
tasks.environment: GPUMode TriMul harness on NVIDIA A100; hardware-specific results are not interchangeable.

current_record.note: No later exact A100 leaderboard row was independently extracted in this snapshot.

tasks.name: Single-cell RNA-seq denoising — PBMC
tasks.question: Discover a denoising transformation that reconstructs held-out PBMC single-cell RNA counts.
tasks.input: Training data and a starter denoising program; PBMC is held out for final evaluation.
tasks.output: Executable Python denoising algorithm producing the required matrix predictions.
tasks.evaluation: The OpenProblems-derived evaluator averages normalized MSE and Poisson components; higher is better.
tasks.environment: Python scientific-computing environment with OpenProblems v1.0.0-compatible data/evaluator.
